label: TP
reason: All three alerts are True Positives. Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — The sink writes `encodeForHTML(str)` to the response writer. While ESAPI encoding is applied, the underlying `str` originates from `request.getInputStream()` (attacker-controlled); per the balanced encoding policy, attacker-controlled data reaching the sink warrants TP. Alert 2 (java/http-response-splitting): alert-TP — The sink constructs a `Cookie` using `str` from `request.getInputStream()`, allowing potential response splitting via header manipulation. Alert 3 (java/insecure-cookie): alert-TP — The code explicitly sets `cookie.setSecure(false)`, violating the secure requirement.

evidence.note: Response splitting sink: Cookie created with str from InputStream
